Sun Tzu (about 5th century BC), The Art of War, in the English translation of Lionel Giles (1875–1958), 1910. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
